papers.title: PulseLM: A Foundation Dataset and Benchmark for PPG-Text Learning
papers.what: A large-scale PPG-text benchmark: fifteen sources harmonized into twelve question-answering tasks, 1.31M standardized 10-second segments and 3.15M closed-ended question-answer pairs, with baseline PPG-aware language models.
papers.builds_on: Sensor2Text (Chen 2024, ELYUE3NF); Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); TS-Agent (Liu 2025, I2CIT4I7)

papers.title: SIGMA-PPG: Statistical-prior Informed Generative Masking Architecture for PPG Foundation Model
papers.what: Replaces random masking in PPG pretraining with a reinforcement-learning teacher that uses amplitude and skewness priors to build hard masking curricula, because random masking is trivial on quasi-periodic signals.

papers.title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
papers.what: Introduces perceptual intermediate tokens that externalize what a VLM would see under an unseen viewpoint; beats textual chain-of-thought and raises multiview-counting accuracy by 3.4% with no image generated at inference.

papers.title: On Information Self-Locking in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM agents
papers.what: Names a failure mode where outcome-reward RL agents stop asking informative questions; decomposes active reasoning into Action Selection and Belief Tracking and shows weak versions of both trap the agent in a low-information loop.
